tldr: Mars through the 10th house heats up career, visibility, reputation, pressure, and ambition.
body:
When Mars moves through your 10th house, it adds heat and urgency to career, visibility, reputation, pressure, ambition, authority, and how you are being seen. You may notice how much attention is on your responsibilities, your public role, or the direction you are trying to build.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a visible choice with more intention.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is measuring your whole self by what is productive, impressive, or approved.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
